scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@monopoly/shared && npm run test --workspace=@monopoly/server
scripts.format: prettier --write shared/src server/src server/test client/src scripts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check shared/src server/src server/test client/src scripts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test --workspace=@monopoly/server && npm run test --workspace=@monopoly/client
scripts.coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=@monopoly/client && npm run test:coverage --workspace=@monopoly/server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace=@monopoly/shared && npm run build --workspace=@monopoly/server && playwright test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run check:circ && npm run check:dup
